title: AgentV Scenario Pack manifest (pack.yaml) v1.0.0
description: Declarative manifest at the root of an installable scenario pack. The installer (eval_runner.catalog.install_pack) enforces this contract fail-closed: missing 'name' aborts; declared 'files' checksums are verified before any bytes are copied.

name.description: Pack namespace. Installs to industries/<name>/<flavor>/<version>/. Lowercase slug; no spaces.

flavor.description: Regulatory/vertical flavor segment of the install path.

version.description: Version segment of the install path. For git-sourced packs prefer the ref tag.

files.description: OPTIONAL tamper-evidence map: relative path -> lowercase sha256 hex of file bytes. When present, EVERY listed file is verified and ANY mismatch aborts installation before copying. Files not listed are copied unverified.

scenarios.description: Optional informational index of contained scenarios.
